reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is openUrlByHostname(host) where host = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Data flow: user input → param → host → URL construction → network fetch. While isNonPublicAddress() checks exist, they only block loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local IPs. Attacker-controlled hostnames can resolve to public IPs or cloud metadata endpoints (e.g., 169.254.169.254) that bypass these checks. The separate DNS resolution and outbound fetch pattern allows SSRF exploitation.

evidence.note: User input flows to host variable, then to openUrlByHostname(host) sink at line 45
DNS resolution via resolveHost(host) followed by isNonPublicAddress check, but insufficient to prevent SSRF
